items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Do you know who he is? Jack, he died. ... That's Jack. ... Jack died when he was 8 years old.

ctx.x: His first son was born. He died.
Do you know who he is? Jack, he died.
He was born in '26. There is a picture of a boy by a car in New York. Now is that Jack?
